name: peaqos
description: Drive peaqOS machine activation, lifecycle, subscriptions, DID management, MCR, monetization, Scale, Stream and Solana onboarding from the peaqos CLI. Needs CLI 0.0.9 or newer (Economics 2.0). Supports peaq mainnet and agung testnet; homing a machine on Solana mainnet needs the CLI release that ships --chain solana.

cli_dependency.notes: Requires CLI 0.0.9 or newer and Python 3.10 or newer. Solana needs CLI 0.0.10 or newer with peaq-os-sdk 0.8.0 (released 2026-09-16), the SDK [solana] extra and [ows] for the wallet flow. If a command group is missing, upgrade with pip install -U peaq-os-cli. Check the Solana gate before onboarding.
